change: Added LATENITE, Cue by Cue (Music & places) and The Bellamy Family tree (People & community) on Gordon's 10/30 yes; Boss Rush phone and PC related links from 10/29 kept.
person_made_it: Yes: every entry is something Gordon made with Darby for real people, now including his family's own tree and a night he shared with friends.
emcee_who_is_speaking: A quiet curator's voice, short labels that say what each thing is and what you can do there.
what_time_of_day_is_this_room: Late morning in a gallery: warm paper, good light, nothing shouting.
did_the_click_pay_me: Yes for the new links: one tap from FINAL BOSS lands on a playable game instead of a team page you have to scroll through.
works_for_the_recipient: A visitor finds the family tree and LATENITE in the collections they belong to, the cards name no relatives or friends, and the page still works with JS off.
taught_me_something: A little: the family card says the tree spans seven generations, taken from the tree's own page.
told_me_the_truth: Yes: both descriptions come from the sites' own text, and the friends' dedications and living relatives' names stay on the sites, not on the cards.
weakest: Text-only cards for LATENITE and Boss Rush are easy to miss in a long list; a small still for each would help.
